summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the default standard in 2026 for connecting AI agents to external tools, data, and services through a unified interface. The ecosystem spans aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of tools, gateways that handle auth and routing at scale, and individual servers that expose specific capabilities like browser automation, repo management, and design handoff. For AI agents, MCP matters because it turns passive assistants into actors that can read, write, and execute across real-world systems securely.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (Composio, Smithery, mcp.so) are marketplaces/hubs that expose many tools through one connection; gateways (agentgateway, Cloudflare MCP, Kong MCP) sit as proxies providing auth, security, and routing in front of servers; individual servers (Playwright, GitHub, Figma) each expose one specific integration or capability.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Repositories, issues, pull requests, actions, code search, and GitHub API automation
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; GitHub Team/Enterprise for advanced org features
strengths: First-party official server from GitHub
Deep coverage of repo, issue, and PR workflows
Default pick across Cursor, Claude, and VS Code
tools.best_for: Automating repository and development workflows directly from AI coding agents

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation, end-to-end testing, web scraping, and UI interaction via accessibility tree
strengths: Reliable deterministic browser control without screenshots
Backed by Microsoft's Playwright team
Top choice for frontend and QA agent workflows
tools.best_for: Giving agents the ability to browse, test, and interact with real web pages

tools.name: Filesystem MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Local file read/write, directory navigation, and file editing with access controls
strengths: Reference implementation maintained by Anthropic
Essential building block for local coding agents
Simple, secure scoped file access
tools.best_for: Letting agents safely read and modify local project files

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ apps including Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear, Jira with managed auth
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers for higher volume and enterprise SSO/support
strengths: Huge catalog of pre-built integrations
Managed OAuth and authentication handling
Strong Cursor and agent framework support
tools.best_for: Connecting agents to hundreds of SaaS tools without building each integration

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Thousands of MCP servers and tools with hosted auth, credentials, and sessions
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting and team plans for scaled usage
strengths: Largest discovery registry of MCP servers
Handles auth, credentials, and sessions for you
One-click deployment and hosting
tools.best_for: Discovering and deploying MCP servers quickly at scale

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Design files, components, variables, and design-to-code handoff context
tools.pricing_paid: Requires Figma paid plans for full Dev Mode features
strengths: Official Dev Mode MCP server from Figma
Bridges design and code for agents
Accurate design context extraction
tools.best_for: Translating Figma designs into code through AI agents

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP server hosting, OAuth, and Workers/Durable Objects-based deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans based on usage and compute
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting with OAuth
Globally distributed edge deployment
Strong security and scaling primitives
tools.best_for: Hosting and securing remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, auth, storage, and project management via natural language
tools.pricing_paid: Supabase Pro and team plans for production workloads
strengths: Official server for database-driven agents
Query, migrate, and manage Postgres from agents
Popular in full-stack AI development
tools.best_for: Letting agents interact with databases and backend infrastructure

tools.name: Docker MCP
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers via a catalog and secure gateway with secrets management
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Business/Team subscriptions for advanced features
strengths: Secure sandboxed execution of MCP servers
Curated MCP catalog with easy setup
Built-in secrets and isolation
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely in isolated containers

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and workspace content for reading and writing
tools.pricing_paid: Notion paid plans for team workspaces and advanced permissions
strengths: Official server for knowledge and docs workflows
Rich read/write access to Notion workspaces
Widely adopted for agent memory and documentation
tools.best_for: Connecting agents to team knowledge bases and documentation

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Error monitoring, issue triage, performance data, and debugging context
tools.pricing_paid: Sentry Team/Business plans for higher event volume
strengths: Official server surfacing production errors to agents
Accelerates automated debugging workflows
Strong adoption among backend developers
tools.best_for: Giving agents access to error and observability data for debugging

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Payments, customers, invoices, subscriptions, and Stripe API operations
strengths: Official server for payment and billing automation
Safe scoped access to financial operations
Growing adoption for commerce agents
tools.best_for: Enabling agents to manage payments and billing data
